run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T04:47:37Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by 500 responses that frontend-proxy passed through from frontend's /api/data route: in the sampled trace 2fad87df8e98273fdb3b8bc591297c8f, the failure is frontend's gRPC call to AdService/GetAds returning status 14 UNAVAILABLE with 'connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080', the cluster IP of Service ad. Frontend's error spans are confined to GET, GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds'; /api/cart and /api/checkout routes stayed at zero errors. Ad's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds fell from ~0.95-1.02/s to 0 and the ad pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh, created by the Deployment ad rollout at 04:48:57 (old pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc deleted at 04:48:59), did not begin emitting request logs until 04:56:23, while its container was 93-100% CPU-throttled at its 50m CPU limit and the Deployment defines no readiness, startup or liveness probe. So the supported cause is Deployment ad's revision-2 change, which replaced the only ad replica with a pod Kubernetes declared Ready before the application was listening on 8080, leaving frontend without an ad backend for roughly 04:49:35-04:56:23. The flagd fault flag adFailure (defaultVariant 'on' in the flagd-config ConfigMap) remains a candidate that does not match the observed transport-level failure, and the ad pod restarted zero times, so no ad crash or OOM occurred.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error signal rose inside the alert window: sum by (span_name,status_code) of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy"} shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR on span_name="ingress" and span_name="router frontend egress" (status tags error=true, http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR), with ingress error rate 0.011/s at 04:49:37, 0.211/s at 04:50:37, peak 1.037/s at 04:54:37, and 0.0148/s by 05:02:37.
The summed frontend-proxy error rate for the same metric reached 2.048/s at 04:54:37 (0.4037/s at 04:50:37), the same order of magnitude as the 2.4556 value recorded in the alert annotation.

frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans are confined to span_name GET, GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder stay at 0 errors throughout the window.

Trace 2fad87df8e98273fdb3b8bc591297c8f shows the failing path: load-generator span GET (http.status_code 500) -> frontend-proxy span 'ingress' (500) -> frontend-proxy span 'router frontend egress' (500) -> frontend span GET and GET /api/data (500) -> frontend span 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' (500, exception.type 14) -> frontend span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and grpc.error_message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080'.

The refused address 100.70.197.56:8080 is Service ad in namespace otel-demo (clusterIP 100.70.197.56, port 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad), so the refused connection is to the ad Service, not to another dependency.

ad was serving normally immediately before the rollout: the 5-minute rate of ad's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds is 0.9519/s at 04:47:37, 1.0111/s at 04:48:37 and 1.0185/s at 04:49:37; it then falls to 0.7963/s at 04:50:37, 0.6481/s at 04:51:37, 0.4519/s at 04:52:37, 0.2/s at 04:53:37, 0.0037/s at 04:54:37 and 0 for the evaluation points 04:55:37 through 04:57:37, recovering to 0.2766/s at 04:58:37; no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series exists for ad's GetAds span in this window.

Kubernetes events show the ad Deployment replacing its only replica during the incident: Deployment ad 'Scaled up replica set ad-785b4464f5 from 0 to 1' at 04:48:57, ReplicaSet ad-785b4464f5 'Created pod: ad-785b4464f5-9bshh' at 04:48:57, Pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc 'Killing - Stopping container ad' at 04:48:59 and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 'Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-w5fhc' at 04:48:59.

Deployment otel-demo/ad currently has replicas=1, strategy RollingUpdate with maxSurge 25% and maxUnavailable 25%, and its single container 'ad' has resources limits cpu=50m / memory=450Mi with readinessProbe, livenessProbe and startupProbe all null; the two ad ReplicaSets both carry image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, with ad-554b849958 at 0 replicas and ad-785b4464f5 at 1.

Pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh has startTime 2026-11-17T04:48:57Z, its ad container has been running since 04:48:59Z with restartCount 0 and empty lastState, and its Ready condition is True with lastTransitionTime 04:48:59Z (no readiness probe exists), while its podIP 100.96.3.224 is exactly the address listed for the ad Endpoints object.

The new ad container was pinned at its CPU limit and heavily throttled: container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total / container_cpu_cfs_periods_total for pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh container ad is 0.939 at 04:50:00, 0.977 at 04:52:00, 0.991 at 04:54:00 and 1.0 at 04:55:00-04:57:00, while its CPU usage rate rises from 0.0097 to 0.0491-0.0493 cores over 04:50:00-04:57:00, i.e. at the 50m limit.

The new ad pod's retained log output contains no request handling before 04:56:23: in the window 04:44:00-04:57:00 the earliest of its 58 matching lines is at 04:56:23.707Z, and that line plus the following ones are ad request logs ('no baggage found in context', 'Targeted ad request received for [telescopes]', 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.'), continuing to the read-through 04:59:47Z.

frontend-proxy's access log records the same pass-through failure, e.g. 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=travel HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' with upstream host frontend 100.96.3.87:8080 at 04:55:51Z, while /api/products/*, /api/cart, POST /api/cart and /api/recommendations are logged as 200 in the same period.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running; frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-kxdcl (started 04:16:51Z, restartCount 0) and frontend-675fd7b5c5-x27kw (started 04:16:53Z, restartCount 0) did not restart, so the proxy and frontend processes themselves were not restarted during the failure.

The only pod with a restart in otel-demo is fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-zzt65 (restartCount 1), whose previous container terminated with reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137 at finishedAt 2026-11-17T04:23:35Z.

The flagd-config ConfigMap in otel-demo currently holds demo.flagd.json with fault-injection flags, including adFailure defaultVariant 'on' (description 'Fail ad service'), adHighCpu 'off', adManualGc 'off', and others such as paymentFailure 'off' and cartFailure 'off'.

Main hypothesis for the alert: Deployment otel-demo/ad revision 2 replaced its single ad replica at 04:48:57-04:48:59; because the container has no readiness/startup probe the new pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh was declared Ready at 04:48:59 while its CPU-throttled container had not yet bound port 8080, so Service ad had no serving backend from about 04:49:35 to 04:56:23 - frontend's GetAds got ECONNREFUSED, /api/data returned 500, and frontend-proxy reported the 500s that triggered RequestErrorRate.

The roughly seven-minute delay before the new ad container served traffic is best explained by CPU starvation under the Deployment's 50m CPU limit (93-100% of CFS periods throttled and usage pinned at ~0.049 cores), not by an application crash, since restartCount stayed 0 and lastState is empty.

The adFailure flag ('Fail ad service', defaultVariant 'on') in the flagd-config ConfigMap is a remaining candidate fault injection for ad, but it is not established as this incident's cause because an app-level ad failure would produce ad-side spans and gRPC error responses, whereas the observed path is a transport-level ECONNREFUSED with zero ad GetAds spans; what its value was during the incident is also unknown.

The failure is scoped to the ad dependency rather than to frontend or the proxy as a whole: frontend's /api/cart, POST /api/cart and /api/checkout spans report zero errors and frontend-proxy logged 200 for /api/products, /api/cart, POST /api/cart and /api/recommendations during the failure window.

fraud-detection's OOMKilled container (exit 137 at 04:23:35Z, restartCount 1) is rejected as the cause of the frontend-proxy error-rate alert: it precedes the error deviation (which starts about 04:49:35) and its consumer path (checkout) shows zero errors throughout the window.

gaps: No change_history integration is available, so what field changed in Deployment otel-demo/ad between revision 1 and revision 2 at 04:48:57Z (and whether the 50m CPU limit changed then) is unknown.

The Prometheus rule named RequestErrorRate was not found: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no rules, so the alert's exact expression, threshold and evaluation window are unknown.
frontend pod logs were unavailable (0 bytes read for frontend-675fd7b5c5-x27kw container frontend), so frontend's own runtime error text for the 500s could not be read directly.

flagd pod logs could not be read (0 lines for init-config, flagd and flagd-ui), so whether flagd was serving adFailure='on' at incident time is unverified; the ConfigMap value is only its state at query time.

A fetch_pod_logs error-filtered search on ad-785b4464f5-9bshh returned no matching lines, and a networkpolicy query for otel-demo returned no objects; an empty result does not prove absence of error lines or of policies.

load-generator has no service_name series in traces_span_metrics_calls_total, so its error rate is unknown beyond the single sampled trace that shows one load-generator GET span with http.status_code 500.

Kubernetes events for fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-zzt65 show 'Created container'/'Started container' entries at 04:55:47Z while its restartCount is 1 with the last termination at 04:23:35Z; this discrepancy is unexplained and its impact was not observed on any sampled path.
Spans and error-rate metrics come from a sampled Jaeger view and span counts, not from unique request counts, so absolute request volumes behind the alert value are not established.
next_steps: Add a readiness/startup probe (HTTP or gRPC health on port 8080) to the ad container and, if startup needs it, raise its CPU limit above 50m so the pod is not routed traffic before it is listening.

Review the Deployment otel-demo/ad revision-2 change (deploy history or Helm release metadata) to identify what triggered the 04:48:57Z rollout, and consider running more than one ad replica or maxUnavailable=0 so a slow replacement cannot remove the only ad backend.
Confirm whether the flagd flag adFailure is intended to be 'on' in this environment and turn it off if not, to remove it from the candidate set.
Validate the fix with a controlled ad rollout while watching Service ad endpoints, ad container CPU throttling, and frontend GetAds error spans.
